# ankra_security_report_schedule (Resource)

The recurring security report one cluster emails. A cluster has at most one schedule, so this is a per-cluster settings resource. The platform has no delete: destroying the resource stores the schedule paused with no recipients, so no report is sent. The counterpart of `ankra security report-schedule set`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_security_report_schedule" "production" {
  cluster_id = ankra_cluster.production.id
  frequency  = "weekly"
  recipients = ["security@example.com", "platform-team@example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster the schedule belongs to. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `frequency` (String) `weekly` or `monthly`.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether reports are sent; `false` stores the schedule paused. Defaults to `true`.
- `recipients` (List of String) Recipient email addresses, at most 20; at least one while `enabled`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The cluster id.
- `last_sent_at` (String) When the last report was sent.
- `next_due_at` (String) When the next report is due.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Report schedules are imported by cluster id.
terraform import ankra_security_report_schedule.production 6a7b8c9d-0e1f-4a2b-8c3d-4e5f6a7b8c9d
```
